## Checklist

Before submitting your PR, please ensure the following:

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding style and conventions
- [ ] I have added/updated unit tests for my changes
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py"` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets (credentials, API keys) have been committed
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (if applicable)
- [ ] Changes are scoped and focused on a single issue
- [ ] Commit messages follow the project's format (imperative mood)
- [ ] I have reviewed my own code before submitting
- [ ] I have linked related issues in the description above
